remarks: Set along a private road in Wilton's coveted Silver Spring community-once part of the historic Firestone estate thoroughbred racetrack-this beautifully updated Colonial pairs timeless character with a fresh, sophisticated interior. Recently refinished and lightened hardwood floors flow throughout, including newly installed hardwoods on the upper level. At the heart of the home, the white chef's kitchen features quartz countertops, Sub-Zero and Thermador appliances, and a generous center island opening to a vaulted family room with custom built-ins and a striking fireplace. Formal living and dining rooms offer inviting spaces to gather, while a private study provides a dedicated home office. Upstairs, the serene primary suite includes two walk-in closets and a marble bath with dual sinks, joined by three additional spacious bedrooms and a hall bath. The finished walk-out lower level expands the living space with room for recreation, fitness or relaxation, plus a fabulous mudroom off the garage. Outside, a large Trex deck overlooks the level, professionally landscaped backyard. Additional enhancements include a new water-filtration system at the point of entry with a new reverse osmosis system at the kitchen sink, whole-house generator and Lutron lighting. Close to Wilton schools, town center, Ambler Farm, Weir Farm and Ridgefield's Main Street. Truly a move in ready property in an idyllic Wilton neighborhood.
